title: UCR uResearch — Undergraduate Research (University of California, Riverside)
description:
UC Riverside's central undergraduate-research gateway, connecting students across every college to faculty-mentored research, funding, and the campus's research programs. It is the starting point for finding a lab, learning how to get involved in research, and navigating undergraduate research opportunities at UCR.

From the program page: Undergraduate Research Create, Innovate, and Chart a Course to Change the World Our undergraduate students graduate prepared to change the world. From academic internships to fieldwork, undergraduate students at UCR make things happen — and make things better. Across all majors — from the sciences to the arts — they engage in the exploration of their greatest passions, generating innovative ideas

description:
